rights.weights: first-party (trained by PDFScoreBar from random initialization); covered by the repository license decision in #505
rights.training_data: procedural synthetic notation tiles generated by tools/issue533/synth_score.py (OpenCV primitives and OpenCV built-in Hershey fonts); no score PDF, evaluation image, ground truth, third-party image or other model output

provenance.determinism: CUDA kernels and data-loader worker interleaving are not bit-deterministic; retraining gives an equivalent but not byte-identical model. The shipped bytes are the evaluated ones.
provenance.note: An earlier run of the same recipe (s1, pre-formatting script bytes not retained) passed the same Full68 screening; this retrained artifact from the committed scripts is the shipped and evaluated one.
provenance.training_source: trained from the tools/issue533 scripts whose SHA-256 values are recorded above (identical to the files in this repository; tests/test_issue533_first_party_sr.py checks them)
